title: Driver-Assistance Sensor Removal Add-On to the Teardown — Repair Estimates & Appointments Tariff Lines
content:
Tariff lines for Repair Estimates & Appointments teardowns — removing and refitting driver-assistance sensors.

Removing and refitting driver-assistance sensors adds a sensor add-on to the teardown charge. The add-on is read from the vehicle's ADAS Sensor Calibrations order in completed status and the systems it covered:

| Vehicle's completed network calibration order (ADAS Sensor Calibrations) | Sensor add-on |
|---|---|
| Covered multiple systems | 145.00 USD |
| Covered a single system (a forward camera, a blind spot radar or a front radar) | 85.00 USD |
| No completed network calibration order | none |

A vehicle whose completed network calibration order covered multiple systems adds 145.00 USD; a vehicle whose completed network calibration order covered a single system adds 85.00 USD; a vehicle with no completed network calibration order adds none.

Hypothetical vehicles: a completed Multi-System Calibration order covering multiple systems — 145.00 USD; a completed Front Radar Calibration order covering the front radar alone — 85.00 USD; a calibration order that was opened but cancelled, with no completed order — none.
